required.description: Locate a natural fire source (lightning strike, wildfire, lava) without using it.

optional_pool.description: Craft and use at least 3 distinct Oldowan-tier stone tools.
Crack open and extract the marrow from 5 scavenged long bones.
Find/reach a colder or more exposed biome edge and turn back once.
Survive a night without tree cover at least once, relying on group vigilance.

milestone.description: Successfully transfer/capture fire from a natural source into a sustainable form for the first time.
